title: Tidings for the Season
overview: A local newscaster’s life changes when he meets a 10-year-old fan — and his single mother — during the holidays.

title: Sealed with a List
overview: Carley is determined to get through her list of abandoned resolutions from last year and enlists the help of coworker Wyatt.

title: My Christmas Family Tree
overview: When Vanessa receives the results from her Family Tree DNA test, she discovers a family she didn't know existed and travels to their home for Christmas.
